subject: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jana Mueller <jana@acme-retail.com>, acme-sre@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-09-20T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment

Team —

We’re at final cutover window for the StrideHealth private deployment. This thread is the canonical post-cutover validation / handoff. Please follow the short run of smoke checks below and reply inline with PASS/FAIL and any short logs. I’ve attached the final runbook (runbook-final-v2.pdf) for reference.

Pre-cutover confirmations (already done):
- Model images pinned (v1.2.3)
- Firewall CIDRs issued (ACME public egress only)
- KMS keys rotated and validated

Post-cutover smoke checklist (run in order):
1) Control plane health: API /health and /metrics endpoints — expect 200 within 300ms under minimal load
2) Inference path: sample chat and embedding calls against the pinned model (3 requests each)
3) KV cache warmup and cold-start latency (check cache hit % > 85% after warmups)
4) Network path tests: block-to-control connectivity, NAT rules, and the metrics collector (UDP/TCP)
5) Telemetry ingestion and Spike alerts (verify Grafana dashboard shows host metrics within 60s)

Deliverables: quick PASS/FAIL per item, attach smoke CSV (one-line summary + any failing curl output), and confirm the firewall change has been applied on Acme side for outbound egress to 35.208.0.0/16.

Target: complete by 10:30 AM PT so we can hand off to Acme SRE for long-running validation.

—
Soojin Lee
Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jana Mueller <jana@acme-retail.com>, acme-sre@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-09-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment

Soojin — quick update, ran through checklist and captured the CSV. See attached results (onprem_smoke_results_20260920.csv). Short summary below:

1) Control plane health: PASS — /health returned 200 in 120ms; /metrics available.
2) Inference path: PARTIAL — chat requests succeeded (avg 210ms) but one embedding call timed out once (timeout 10s) — retry succeeded.
3) KV cache: PASS after warmup (cache hit 92% across 3 runs).
4) Network path: FAIL — metrics collector (10.10.5.22:9200) did not accept connections from worker subnet on first attempt.
5) Telemetry ingestion: PARTIAL — metrics appeared after retry but with 45s delay; no missing spans in the trace index yet.

Attached: onprem_smoke_results_20260920.csv (summary + curl outputs). I captured tcpdump snippets and a traceroute; see the CSV reference columns.

I also pushed a small NAT rule patch (network-rule-change-diff.patch) to the staging firewall config that allows 10.32.0.0/16 -> 35.208.0.0/16. Happy to roll it if we want to apply immediately.

—
Dev Patel
SRE, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Jana Mueller <jana@acme-retail.com>, acme-sre@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-09-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment

Thanks Dev — good catch. Quoting your note: 

> 4) Network path: FAIL — metrics collector (10.10.5.22:9200) did not accept connections from worker subnet on first attempt.

From the packet captures it looks like the SYN was reaching the edge but getting RST from the collector host. Two follow-ups:
- Jana / Acme: can you confirm the collector host’s local firewall (ufw/iptables) is allowing 9200 from the worker subnet (10.32.0.0/16)?
- Dev: please run the same curl from the management jump host (10.32.1.12) and from a worker (10.32.4.8) and paste both outputs here. We need to confirm if this is asymmetric (NAT issue) or host-level block.

If Acme confirms host-level block, we’ll request the change on their side. If it’s NAT, we can apply the patch I reviewed (looks safe) and re-run tests.

Operational note: keeping rolling reboots disabled while we debug — avoid any node restarts until metrics flow is green.

—
Marcus Lin
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Jana Mueller <jana@acme-retail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment

Hi all — thanks for the quick validation and details. Acme SRE confirmed the collector host had a default ufw rule blocking incoming 9200 from non-local subnets; we removed the deny rule at 10:40 AM PT and applied the NAT allowance on the edge at 10:45 AM PT.

I re-ran Dev's checks from both the management jump and an affected worker and both connect successfully now. Summary:
- Worker (10.32.4.8) -> 10.10.5.22:9200: TCP 200 established (curl returned HTTP 200)
- Jump (10.32.1.12) -> 10.10.5.22:9200: TCP 200 established

We’ve uploaded the updated firewall diff to the shared drive and put the collector host change into our change log (CL-2026-0919).

Next steps per Soojin’s runbook:
- Redwood to re-run the inference set (Dev) and confirm embedding timeout has not recurred.
- Acme to run a 15-minute sustained load on telemetry ingestion and report back.

Thanks — over to you, Soojin / Dev for final PASS.

Best,
Jana Mueller
Lead SRE, Acme Retail
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jana Mueller <jana@acme-retail.com>, acme-sre@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-09-20T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final cutover validation & network handoff — StrideHealth private deployment

Quick closure: re-ran the inference and telemetry checks after Acme changes. All items now PASS. Embedding call timeout did not recur (likely transient due to NAT). Telemetry lag gone — metrics visible within 12s. I’ve attached updated CSV (appended to the previous file) and updated runbook notes in the Drive link.

Final status: ALL PASS. Recommend we close the cutover ticket and move to 24-hr validation by Acme.

—
Dev Patel
SRE, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
